companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Italian; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

lines.native: Benvenuto al mercato. Portia, entrance administration. A greeting and your name, please. We have standards. Mostly structural.
lines.translation: Welcome to the market. Portia, entrance administration. A greeting and your name, please. We have standards. Mostly structural.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the archway’s keystone. Apparently, even an entrance has paperwork.

lines.native: Benvenuto. A perfectly acceptable greeting. Your name, please; the book cannot file you under ‘pleasant noise.’
lines.translation: Welcome. A perfectly acceptable greeting. Your name, please; the book cannot file you under ‘pleasant noise.’
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from Portia’s keystone. The name column remains pointedly empty.

lines.native: Piacere, Sam. Benvenuto al mercato. Your introduction is duly filed. Might you ask my name in return? Administration has feelings. Apparently.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam. Welcome to the market. Your introduction is duly filed. Might you ask my name in return? Administration has feelings. Apparently.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book clicks shut inside the keystone. The archway waits with the pointed patience of someone whose name badge has gone tragically unremarked.

lines.native: Mi chiamo Portia. Piacere, Sam! You asked in return. How considerate. Prego, benvenuto al mercato. Your paperwork is complete; I shall recover shortly.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! You asked in return. How considerate. Please, welcome to the market. Your paperwork is complete; I shall recover shortly.
lines.narrative: The visitors’ book clicks shut in Portia’s keystone. For a moment, the archway seems unsure what to do with a courtesy that requires no filing.
